title: B. Noisy partial barge-in: the correction is clipped by a dropped pan (Lab 3 Test B, revised)
story: Same misrecognised call. The user shouts 'No, wait!' but drops a pan, so the recogniser only gets '…imer'. In Lab 3 the system stopped the call and went silent.

expect.said: Call to Mom cancelled before it connected. Did you want a timer?
